class: Development-only experiment; not a pipeline profile change; not release-qualified evidence
frozenBefore: any B1 candidate outcome (preflight counters, Arm B output or evaluation) was computed
question: Does a scale-normalised, model-neutral sharpness assessment, applied only to Vehicle NearView eligibility, make additional O5 oracle-readable ground-truth Tracks evidence-readable in their sealed evidence, without losing currently readable Tracks?
provenanceOfHypothesis: Follow-on hypothesis selected from the exploratory sharpness-floor diagnostic (sharpness-study.json f9930bca..., 19/26 readable-but-failing frames reach 0.05 at a fixed 128-px height). Same BDD100K data family; NOT an independent validation population. 19/26 is not a predicted B1 hit count.

intervention.kind: qualification-only: eligibility for NearView changes; quality_micro, selection_micro and the holder's recorded area are the production scorer's values, unchanged
intervention.metric: mavi_vision.quality.scoring._normalized_sharpness over the WHOLE resized array (mean |grey gradient| / 64, production formula), where the array is the production crop_region(frame, box) of the decoded video frame
intervention.applyWhen: native crop height in pixels (rows of crop_region) > 128; otherwise no experimental value exists and only the original sharpness applies (never upscale)
intervention.resizedWidthPx: max(1, round(nativeWidth * 128 / nativeHeight)) with Python round()
intervention.interpolation: Pillow Image.resize((width, 128), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR), default reducing_gap (None), on the contiguous uint8 RGB crop; Pillow 11.3.0 (antialiasing triangle filter when downscaling)
intervention.qualifiedOriginal: confidence >= confidenceFloor AND sharpness >= sharpnessFloor AND edgeMargin >= edgeMarginFloor AND occlusionIou < occlusionIouCeiling (production rule)
intervention.qualifiedNearB1: qualifiedOriginal OR (vehicle AND confidence >= confidenceFloor AND edgeMargin >= edgeMarginFloor AND occlusionIou < occlusionIouCeiling AND b1Sharpness is defined AND b1Sharpness >= sharpnessFloor)
intervention.selectorRule: For every candidate the unchanged production EvidenceSelector.observe runs first. Then, only for a b1Only candidate, the unchanged production NearView rule is applied with the holders as they stand: not a near-duplicate of the Representative AND (no NearView holder OR area > holder area * (1 + nearViewGrowth)); the crop is encoded by the unchanged encoder and role cap and held only if admissible. A b1Only candidate never enters Representative qualification, EarlyDiverse or LateDiverse, and is not counted as qualified.
intervention.admittedHolderMarking: a NearView held from a b1Only candidate is recorded with qualified=false and logged as B1-experiment-admitted, never as release-qualified
intervention.inputsNotUsed: no ground-truth plate pixels, plate boxes, truth text, OCR or recognition output, and no outcome of any arm

unchanged: release pipeline profile phase1-detection-tracking-v1 (afb03b6c...) and every threshold in it
EarlyDiverse and LateDiverse eligibility (original qualification only)
confidence, edge-margin, occlusion and NearView growth-hysteresis gates
JPEG encoder, role byte caps, staging and run-level admission
ByteTrack tracker and the retained X1 detector streams (no detector inference)

population.detections: E:/MAVI-Controlled/Benchmarks/stage4-x1/live/detections/*.detections.jsonl, each bound to the X1 live index

evaluation.primary: O5 human-reviewed truth 8d1d03b2..., E-A db2656f1... (h_min 32 px), both pinned instruments, frozen Stage-3 association policy; x1_eval.evaluate per arm; accepted baseline 53/79 (E-B b3aa0b4d...)
evaluation.historicalControl: 51/77 (AI labels, truth 709a560b...) is NOT the B1 decision population
evaluation.trackGain: oracle-readable GT Track with evidenceReadable false in Arm A and true in Arm B
evaluation.trackLoss: oracle-readable GT Track with evidenceReadable true in Arm A and false in Arm B
evaluation.unmeasurable: a changed Arm-B observation at a frame without a plate label (frozen rule: skipped) can neither gain nor lose; it is counted and reported, never claimed
evaluation.ceilingsReported: observed attainable ceiling from the per-candidate records, not 19/26 and not X1's 51+10

stopCriteria.preflightNull: if zero Vehicle candidates over the complete 200 sequences are b1Only (fail original sharpness, pass b1Sharpness, pass every unchanged confidence/edge/occlusion gate), record a null result with counters and hashes and do not run Phase 1
stopCriteria.inventory: any missing, extra, changed or mismatched input (manifest, video, detections, truth, instruments, code, profile) stops the experiment
stopCriteria.parity: Arm A must equal the retained X1 baseline (every Track, trajectory, observation and crop SHA-256, 200/200) and its O5 evaluation must equal E-B b3aa0b4d... on every Track's state, usablePlate, oracleReadable and evidenceReadable (53/79); otherwise no candidate result is reported
stopCriteria.controls: any Person observation change, any Representative change or any trajectory change between Arm A and Arm B is an implementation defect: stop and fix, no result
stopCriteria.repeat: an independent repeat of each arm must equal the first on canonical decoded records; otherwise the result is invalid

decisionRule.A_reject: net Track gain (gains - losses) <= 0, or any loss with net gain <= 1
decisionRule.C_proposeO3: losses == 0 AND net gain >= 2 (measured, at labelled frames), with Person/Representative/trajectory controls unchanged
decisionRule.B_nextHypothesis: otherwise; names exactly one bounded next hypothesis supported by the per-Track attribution
decisionRule.invariant: the frozen P3 verdict 53/79 INADEQUATE is unchanged by any B1 outcome
